text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
*Pant*, *pant*...
Damn it, it's so hot...

text_block_list.name: Fired-Up Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Gutsy Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Seiyyyaaa!!
Seiya! SEIYAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Tch.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —I'm doing one more rep before I lose the feel of it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, yeah. Just one more, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the summer training camp reaching its peak, the horsegirls were bursting with sheer intensity.
Narita Taishin seemed determined not to be outdone, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, just watching her makes me anxious.
If only there were a way for her to catch her breath and unwind...

text_block_list.name: Gutsy Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
—All right! That wraps up today's menu, Trainer!
Just like we promised, time to get ready for the festival!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, the festival. Let's meet up just before 7:00 PM,
right when the fireworks start.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, there was a festival today. But knowing Narita Taishin,
plunging into a packed, bustling festival crowd wouldn't be much of a break.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, it was a rare opportunity.
I wanted her to enjoy herself somehow. If there was a way...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *Gasp*... *sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's clearing out, huh.
Guess there really is a festival on.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
—Works out great if nobody's around.
I can push myself straight to the limit.
choice_data_list: I've got a suggestion, if you're up for it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hm...? What?
choice_data_list: Why don't we head over toward the forest today?
How about heading toward the woods today?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Toward the forest, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Whatever, fine by me.
Not like anyone else is gonna be out that way anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As we made our way over, the sun slowly began to set...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant...*

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Are you planning on going further?
...We came pretty far out, you know.
choice_data_list: No, let's wait here for a moment.
No, I think we should hold on right here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Wait here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The fireworks were set to start at 7:00 PM.
Checking the time, there were five seconds left, four, three, two...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*whistle~~~~... BANG!!*)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Why right at this exact moment...?
Wait, don't tell me you—
choice_data_list: Wow, what an incredible coincidence, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hah, so this was all part of your plan, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*BANG! BANG...!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One after another, fireworks soared upward, painting vibrant colors across the night sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The only sounds reaching us were the wind and the bursting fireworks.
—Amidst the quiet spectacle, Narita Taishin softly let out a murmur.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I really hate festivals and stuff like that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Going all the way to some place swarming with tons of strangers...
I can't fathom it. ...Not like I'd ever go in the first place, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...That whole 'I knew you would say that' vibe is kinda annoying, but whatever.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks... aren't bad, though.
It's way easier on me than watching them crammed in a huge crowd.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: When nobody else is around, you don't have to waste energy walking on eggshells, either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she said, it was easy to see how relaxed she had become.
It seemed that being away from prying eyes was indeed vital to her, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Going by that logic, there seemed to be one glaring exception.
choice_data_list: There's one other person right here, though. You okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Jeez, what are you even bringing that up for now?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: In your case... well—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
—You're pretty much like a fish.
Doesn't really make a difference whether you're here or not.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, fish—I wonder?
Do those things even realize I'm there...? Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well, either way's fine by me.
It just feels like you're 'just there.'

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Honestly... if it stays like that, it's easier on me, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Either way is fine, long as it's you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To Narita Taishin, I was no different than a fish.
Yet to her, those words were surely the greatest—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...What?
Why do you have that goofy look on your face?
choice_data_list: Huh? Is it really that goofy?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it is, dummy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Narita Taishin said that, illuminated by the bursts of fireworks overhead,
her profile carried a gentle, peaceful smile...
